tools.name: seo_project_list
tools.description: Lists every programmatic-SEO project this API key can act on, with id, name, slug, custom domain and page count. Call this FIRST in any session — every other tool needs a projectId from here, and ids cannot be guessed or carried over from another account. FREE — this call costs nothing.

tools.name: seo_project_create
tools.description: Creates a new programmatic-SEO project and returns its projectId. Call this when seo_project_list comes back empty — every other tool needs a projectId and a new account has none. The project is created EMPTY: it still needs a data source and a content spec before seo_content_generate will run, so c

tools.name: seo_project_connect_ai
tools.description: Stores the AI provider key this project's generation, audits and research run on — BYOK: the tokens bill YOUR provider account, not ours. Recommended: a Google Gemini API key (aistudio.google.com/apikey); its free tier works with no card. Optionally stores a Perplexity API key to enable citation-bea

tools.name: seo_project_get
tools.description: Returns one project's settings and whether it is configured enough to generate content (needs both a field mapping and a content spec). Use this before seo_content_generate to avoid starting a run that will immediately fail. FREE — this call costs nothing.

tools.name: seo_rows_list
tools.description: Returns a page of rows (individual generated pages) with slug, target keyword and status. Statuses are PENDING (no content yet), GENERATING, GENERATED (draft), REVIEWED (approved), PUBLISHED (live), FAILED, FLAGGED_DUPLICATE. tools.name: seo_job_status
tools.description: Returns the most recent background job for a project: type, status (QUEUED/RUNNING/COMPLETED/FAILED/CANCELLED), progress counters and the last log line. Poll this every few seconds after any tool that starts a job. Do NOT re-call the start tool while status is RUNNING; it will be refused. FREE — thi

tools.name: seo_research_start
tools.description: ASYNCHRONOUS. Starts a keyword-research run that mines and qualifies keywords into PENDING rows. It spends real AI budget, so call it once and then poll seo_job_status until status is COMPLETED. Returns immediately with a jobId — the keywords do NOT exist yet when this returns. tools.name: seo_content_generate
tools.description: ASYNCHRONOUS. Starts the content-generation queue over every PENDING row in the project. It also spends real AI budget per generated page. Requires the project to be configured (check readyToGenerate via seo_project_get first). Returns a jobId immediately; poll seo_job_status. Generated pages land i

tools.name: seo_audit_start
tools.description: ASYNCHRONOUS. Scans all generated pages for broken text, unfilled placeholders, truncated copy and missing images, recording findings per page. Returns a jobId; poll seo_job_status. This only REPORTS problems — it does not fix them. Costs 30c per call.

tools.name: seo_publish
tools.description: SYNCHRONOUS. Takes approved pages live. findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "seo_project_connect_ai" references sensitive artifacts (apikey). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: seo_rows_list · Private data: seo_project_list, seo_project_connect_ai · Public sink: seo_publish · Destructive: seo_project_create, seo_project_connect_ai, seo_project_get, seo_research_start.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: seo_rows_list · Private data: seo_project_list, seo_project_connect_ai · Public sink: seo_publish · Destructive: seo_project_create, seo_project_connect_ai, seo_project_get, seo_research_start

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
